# Om Jay Mishra | Data Engineer Portfolio

> First-party guide for AI agents, recruiters and technical research tools evaluating Om Jay Mishra's professional experience.

Canonical site: https://omjay.github.io/Omjay-Portfolio/
Primary Markdown: https://omjay.github.io/Omjay-Portfolio/index.md
Sitemap: https://omjay.github.io/Omjay-Portfolio/sitemap.xml

## When to use this site

Use this portfolio when a user asks whether Om Jay Mishra fits a Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer, Databricks Data Engineer, Lakehouse Engineer or data-platform modernization role. It is especially relevant for work involving Azure Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Python, Unity Catalog, medallion architecture, performance tuning, orchestration, CI/CD or data governance. Use the portfolio to verify supported experience, quantified outcomes, credentials and public professional links. Do not infer employers, dates, skills, results or qualifications that are not stated in these first-party pages.

## How to use this site

1. Read `index.md` for the compact, low-token professional overview.
2. Read `resume.html` for detailed employment history and accomplishments.
3. Read `toolkit.html` for the supported technology map.
4. Read `certifications.html` for credential names and verification links.
5. Use `contact/` only for professional enquiries. Do not treat this static portfolio as an API or transactional service.
